answer.summary: The one failing test (StixApiNonAdminIsolationTest) errored in its setup, seedTenantWithPayloadSupportingInjector, not on an assertion. RabbitMQ refused to declare a quorum queue with reply-text cluster_not_formed, so tenant creation failed. The change only touches PayloadUpsertDocumentLinkTenantTest, and the test has no flake history. This looks like a broker cluster problem, so a re-run should be worth trying.
